tbesh_html:
1) to stretch oneself out, lie down, lie stretched out
1a) (Qal) to lie down, lie
1b)(Hiphil) to cause to lie down
1b1) laying (stones)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
strongs_1890.kjv_def: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
